name: io.github.paywithtender/tender
title: Tender
description: Let AI agents pay x402 APIs with any token on Robinhood Chain. Merchants get exact USDG.

environmentVariables.name: TENDER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated agent wallet. Leave out to run read-only.

environmentVariables.name: TENDER_PAY_WITH
environmentVariables.description: Token address to pay with. Defaults to USDG.

environmentVariables.name: TENDER_MAX_PER_CALL_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any API priced above this, in USD. Default 1.

environmentVariables.name: TENDER_DAILY_LIMIT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Total the agent may spend per UTC day, in USD. Default 10.

environmentVariables.name: TENDER_APPROVAL_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Token approval to Permit2, in days of the daily limit. Default 7. Set to 'unlimited' for a one-time unlimited approval.
